_comment: Scenario cards (Zone D). Last config.scenario.rounds rounds. boosted elements deal x boostedMultiplier damage, weakened x weakenedMultiplier. 'rules' are special effects; rules with penalty=true are ignored while Clear Skies is active. Rule types: attackStun, attackDot, turnStartEnergy, fusionAttackBonus, ignoreDefense, fusionDurationBonus, rechargeBonus, fusionHitReduction, noRecharge, fusionCostIncrease.

scenarios.name: Ocean
scenarios.text: Hydro attacks: d6 4-6 Stuns the enemy. Wind attacks summon a Typhoon (5 HP per round for 2 rounds).
scenarios.stemFact: The ocean has soaked up roughly a quarter of the carbon dioxide humans have released, which is slowly making seawater more acidic.

scenarios.name: Desert
scenarios.text: Hydro loses 5 Energy at the start of each of its turns (evaporation).
scenarios.stemFact: A desert is any place that gets less than about 250 mm of rain a year, so the largest desert on Earth is actually icy Antarctica.

scenarios.name: Volcanic Field
scenarios.text: Fire fusion attacks (Raw and Energy) deal +5 damage.
scenarios.stemFact: Volcanic ash weathers into some of the most fertile soil on Earth because it is rich in minerals such as potassium and phosphorus.

scenarios.name: Rainforest
scenarios.text: Plants gain +5 Energy at the start of each of their turns.
scenarios.stemFact: Tropical rainforests cover only about 6% of Earth's land, yet they are home to more than half of all known plant and animal species.

scenarios.name: Mountain Peak
scenarios.text: Wind attacks ignore 25% of the enemy's Defense.
scenarios.stemFact: At the top of Mount Everest the air pressure is only about one third of the pressure at sea level, so each breath holds far less oxygen.

scenarios.name: Arctic Tundra
scenarios.stemFact: Arctic permafrost stores roughly twice as much carbon as there is in the whole atmosphere today, so thawing it could speed up warming.

scenarios.name: Monsoon
scenarios.stemFact: Monsoons happen because land heats up faster than the sea in summer, which flips the seasonal winds and pulls in moist ocean air.

scenarios.name: Underground Cavern
scenarios.text: Earth fusions take 10 less damage from the first enemy hit each round (free Fortify).
scenarios.stemFact: Most limestone caves are carved by rainwater that turned slightly acidic by absorbing carbon dioxide, slowly dissolving the rock over thousands of years.

scenarios.name: Solar Eclipse
scenarios.text: Solar cannot Recharge while this Scenario is active. Other elements are neutral.
scenarios.stemFact: During a total solar eclipse, solar panels in the Moon's shadow produce almost no power, so grid operators plan for the dip in advance.

scenarios.name: Drought
scenarios.text: Water fusion actions (Raw and Energy Attack) cost +5 Energy.
scenarios.stemFact: In a drought, plants close the tiny pores on their leaves (stomata) to save water, which also cuts how much carbon dioxide they can absorb.
